subject: Shade
status: CLOTHING REJECTED by Jacob; superseded by the v3 clothing-only repair. No separate approval inferred for the preserved face/body/codex.
ownerBrief: Female priest-shaman; camp upgrades unlock new orders. Transformed astral scholar, layered ceremonial robes and shifting silhouettes. Same underlying material as other Pals but distinct anatomy, face, palette and corruption. Dark obsidian/black/purple/old-gold, restrained intentional haze; no leader-exclusive features.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original character concept sheet for SHADE, a female dark astral PRIEST-SHAMAN and TRANSFORMED SCHOLAR in Kindred Siege. Her role at camp is unlocking NEW ORDERS. This is a fresh design. The owner wants each of four trusted companions to have radically different anatomy, colouring and silhouette while sharing the same underlying living opalescent skin material, black cult cloth, polished obsidian and old gold. The specific brief for Shade is "transformed astral scholar" with "layered ceremonial robes, shifting silhouettes".

ONE-SECOND HOOK:
An intelligent, uncanny alien priestess stands quietly while three major layers of her black ceremonial robes seem to obey different directions of gravity. Clear asymmetrical silhouette: compact head and fine shoulders, a curved draped collar framing one side of the head, fitted upper torso, a sweeping substantial lower robe with broad offset layers. One sleeve hangs vertically, the other folds back upward in a slow unsupported arch. These are real weighty BLACK CLOTH FOLDS, not wings, feathers, tentacles, a swarm of ribbons or an effects cloud. Give the garment a small number of bold readable shapes with empty space between them; asymmetry should look deliberate and elegant.

THE WOMAN WITHIN THE TRANSFORMATION:
Adult female character, graceful but with physical substance; seven-head heroic proportions, two arms and two legs, no skeletal frailty. Highly transformed and almost completely alien: curved layered collarbones, subtly offset shoulder anatomy, three long smooth interlocking torso planes visible through an opening in the ceremonial layers, long precise fingers. Show a real biological body beneath the clothes, never simply a human model in a robe. No humanoid six-pack, human skin, breast-armour cups, exposed groin or sexualised pose. The owner loosely suggested half skin showing for the group, but for this explicitly robed scholar show face, throat, upper chest, forearms and a restrained opening along one flank; prioritise layered ceremonial robes.

FACE AND PERSONALITY:
An original clearly readable face with TWO large oblique eyes, subtle uneven eyelids, fine expressive cheek contours and a small wry mouth. No protruding human nose or external ears; the central face has a smooth shallow recessed bridge between the eyes. Soft biological nacre planes overlap slightly along the temples and cheeks, with delicate thin membrane at their joins. This looks like a living face shaped by transformation, NOT a hard mask, helmet, skull, robot, familiar movie alien or ordinary fantasy elf. Facial proportions are graceful and distinct from muscular male commanders; no large masculine brow/jaw. One brow lifted almost imperceptibly, gaze sharp, curious and faintly amused, as if she has spotted the flaw in your plan and is deciding how much to tease you about it. Still friendly enough to be a trusted comrade, unsettling through intelligence and altered anatomy rather than a horror sneer.
Head partly framed by a sharply folded asymmetrical black cowl attached to the robes; face fully lit and unobscured. It is cloth, never a crown or supernatural halo.
No transparent brain, third eye, forehead eye, dreads, beard, split crown or royal leader hairstyle. No beak, bird head, horns, avian feet or known Chaos insignia.

MATERIAL, COLOUR AND CORRUPTION:
Her skin is living dark NACRE in deep smoky INDIGO, muted petrol-violet and pewter-pearl reflections. Quiet iridescence depends on light, not emission. Different from pale lavender muscle and swollen plum flesh. The skin is smooth, supple and beautiful with very restrained subdermal charcoal branching that seems to turn back on itself; a few overlapping growth seams indicate transformation. No rot, ulcers, exposed organs, wounds or disease. Organic obsidian augmentation follows collarbone, wrists and waist in thin curved structural forms with sparse ancient-gold joins. No circuit-board traces, industrial pistons, armour suit or metal skin. No neon, luminous cyan, rainbow glitter, galaxy print or bright glowing eyes.
Black layered fabric has tactile woven body; deep purple appears only inside folds. Sparse fine antique-gold stitched diagrams around the cuffs and a small broken cult seal at the fastening. Decoration supports the material, not wall-to-wall glyphs.

ROLE AND GESTURE:
One hand holds a modest folding ritual codex at waist height: three thin curved OBSIDIAN LEAVES joined along a narrow old-gold spine, partly opened like a familiar book, etched with small non-glowing diagrams. Her other fingertip rests on one diagram while she looks sideways toward the viewer. The book is solid, held, readable as a scholar's working text; no floating holographic army, leader-like hovering relic, spell staff, wand or giant magical orb. No furniture, background laboratory or extra characters. This is a visual role prop only, do not imply a new combat ability.
Her body stays composed as robe layers subtly drift around it. Restrained black haze seeps from the garment's inner folds and her wrists, curls with purpose toward the codex, and settles low. Keep all anatomy and the silhouette readable; no afterimage duplicates, extra ghost faces or heavy fog.

PRESENTATION:
Premium original dark science-fantasy character design painting, controlled stylisation, tactile biological and fabric materials, elegant big shapes, moderate detail. Full complete figure three-quarter front on the left 70% of a landscape plate; upper right one matching FACE close-up; lower right one matching small codex-and-hand detail. Consistent anatomy and outfit in all views. Calm warm-grey studio background, soft broad lighting separates dark robes from dark skin, restrained warm gold bounce. Feet or the grounded hem fully visible, sleeves and full outer silhouette never cropped. She is grounded, no levitating disc or flying mount. Small understated title "SHADE", subtitle "ORDERS / PRIEST-SHAMAN". No additional prose or game interface.
Do not clone any earlier character or use generic sexy sorceress styling. Key priorities: instantly distinct asymmetric robe silhouette, living alien feminine face with knowing personality, clear scholar gesture, obsidian/purple/ancient-gold palette, restrained intentional black haze.

research.use: Official description of change, pursuit of knowledge, schemes and transformed followers; official army image inspected for ritual shapes and curved motion. Broad art/personality reference, not imported game mechanics or literal Warhammer likeness. Source image not fed to generation.

inspection: Visually inspected the returned sheet: distinct feminine scholar, two eyes, layered biological cranial planes, black asymmetric cowl, indigo/pewter pearlescent skin, gold/obsidian structural details, black floor-length robe layers with one raised unsupported drape, solid open black/gold codex held and pointed to, dark haze. Main figure, face and book detail agree. Clear separation from the male Pal silhouettes and leader-exclusive features. Limits: face retains small humanlike nose/lips; fine skin highlights are more iridescent than the restrained brief; garment movement is suggested in a still, not proven animation; no owner appearance approval or sprite-scale proof.
scope: One Shade image only. No leader/Glutton art changes; Butcher v4 recorded as provisional after owner moved on. No PixelLab, sprites, animation, gameplay/code/build/Unity changes, commits or pushes.
